row.body: A radio is packed with the house key and a note promising someone will remain at the marked address. The battery receipt is dated after the promised check-in.
row.title: We will stay reachable

sidecar.gloss: A promised check-in outlasts the radio’s recorded battery purchase.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field team could have kept a radio at a work site; the delayed battery receipt does not prove anyone was stranded.

row.body: chalk numbers run across the red pen and camera. the count skips one place, then resumes in a different hand.
row.title: missing count beside the red pen

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
